summary: Iteration 29 (frontend only, 390x844, preview URL): tested the Driver bottom tabs. WORKING: driver mode shows exactly tab-dashboard/'Dashboard', tab-requests, tab-trips, tab-earnings and no passenger tabs. Passenger mode shows the original 5 tabs. Switching mode in Profile updates the tabs straight away, with a toast and a redirect to /. For an approved TEST driver, the Dashboard tab shows the full embedded dashboard (online toggle, services, outstation, 4 tiles, dash-offer-ride/dash-messages/dash-notifications) and no back arrow. dash-header opens /profile, which has a back arrow that works. A driver-mode user with no profile sees driver-home with the choose-rent/book cards and the messages/notifications buttons. The Requests tab has no back arrow, and Accept (which opens /hire/HIR-..) and Reject (toast 'Declined') both work. The Trips tab has the 3 chips, the upcoming list shows the accepted hire (tap opens /hire/[id] with a back arrow), and the empty states work. For driver@, the carpool chip lists 6 rides, and tapping one opens /trip/[id] with a back arrow. The Earnings tab has no back arrow. /hire/availability, /hire/vehicles and /hire/requests (pushed from tiles) show a back arrow that works. The /hire/driver deep link shows the dashboard with a back arrow. Passenger regression passed: all 5 tabs work, and /earnings and /hire/requests open with back arrows. FAILING: (1) CRITICAL: in Driver mode, /messages, /notifications and /offer cannot be reached. dash-messages, dash-notifications, dash-offer-ride, driver-messages, driver-notifications and driver-offer-ride do nothing, and a direct visit to those URLs lands on '/'. (2) The Requests tab badge counts every inbox item, including ones already accepted or rejected. (3) driver@travoo.in is NOT an approved local driver: it has no pro_drivers record, so it sees driver-home and not the dashboard.

ui_bugs.issue: In driver mode these tab screens get href:null. With expo-router 58 on web, a screen with href:null can no longer be reached by URL. router.push('/messages' | '/notifications' | '/offer') does nothing (URL stays '/'), and going to those URLs directly redirects to the Dashboard. This breaks dash-messages, dash-notifications, dash-offer-ride, driver-messages, driver-notifications and driver-offer-ride. Driver-mode users can no longer open Messages, Alerts or Offer a ride at all. Passenger mode shows the same behaviour in reverse: /requests and /trips land on '/'. For /earnings, a passenger falls back to the root app/earnings.tsx, which is fine.

The badge is (r.inbox ?? []).length, which counts every inbox item, including fulfilled ones and ones this driver already accepted or rejected. After the driver accepted one request and rejected the other, the badge still showed 2 when the real number of open requests was 0. dash-tile-requests correctly showed none, because it uses /pro/dashboard open_requests (dispatch response None, status open, starts_at in the future). The badge also only refreshes every 15 s or when the mode changes, not after Accept/Reject.

integration_issues.issue: The review request says driver@travoo.in is an approved local driver after the migration. In the DB it has account_type driver but no pro_drivers document, so the Dashboard tab shows driver-home (choose cards) and not the dashboard. The only approved pro_driver is a real user (upendra..., user_310f8c4adcfb), which was not touched.

issues: dash-offer-ride, dash-messages and dash-notifications are three small buttons in one row at 390px, and their labels are cut off ('Offer a ri...', 'Messag...')
The 'For me (N)' chip on the Requests screen also counts requests that were already answered

action_items: CRITICAL: Hide the tabs that don't belong to the current mode without href:null, so their routes stay reachable. Use options {tabBarItemStyle: {display: 'none'}} or tabBarButton: () => null for mode-hidden tabs in the web/JS Tabs. Another option is to add stack routes for /messages, /notifications and /offer outside (tabs) for driver mode. Then confirm that dash-messages, dash-notifications, dash-offer-ride and the driver-home equivalents open their screens with a back arrow. Watch out: if hidden tabs stay reachable, /earnings will hit (tabs)/earnings for passengers too.

Requests badge: count only items with status==='open' && !dispatch?.response (or reuse /pro/dashboard open_requests), and refresh it after Accept/Reject or when the path changes. Apply the same filter to the 'For me (N)' chip.
Either make driver@travoo.in a real approved local driver, or correct the briefing or credentials note.
Fit the embedded dashboard's three footer buttons at 390px: two rows, icon-only, or shorter labels.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx: the openRequests effect depends only on [driver], so the badge goes stale after an action. Its inbox.length logic does not match the backend's open_requests definition.

Each route now exists twice: app/earnings.tsx alongside (tabs)/earnings.tsx, and app/hire/requests.tsx alongside (tabs)/requests.tsx. Which one handles /earnings depends on the mode, which is fragile.
trips.tsx: failed API calls are swallowed into [] with no error state.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (the Messages/Notifications/Offer navigation in driver mode and the Requests badge fail)
